Discerning Benevolence of Entities

First, you must have a relationship with the Holy Spirit.

“The person without the Spirit does not accept the things that come from the Spirit of God but considers them foolishness, and cannot understand them because they are discerned only through the Spirit.”
— First Corinthians 2:14

A positive encounter≠Benevolence, is not only meaningful to help people avoid deception, it's biblical. 

While it's possible to encounter a benevolent entity, it is extremely unlikley to encounter anything other than Christ or the Holy Spirit. We are on a fallen planet amongst fallen entities that have been here long before us when they were banished from the Heavenly realms.

Angels are not to just be summoned at will. They do not roam freely, only appear under God's command with a clear message, identifying themselves and are never ambiguous. It's a rare encounter usually only to an individual or small group.

We are also in the end times, this means it's a time of increasing deception, testing and judgement. It's not a time for angels to be contacting people everywhere or taking Christ's place as the one who comes to put an end to the chaos.

Christ — Who do they say Jesus is?
Doctrine — Does it match scripture?
Fruit — What does it produce?
Lordship — Does it submit to Christ?

— First Epistle of John 4:1

“For false christs and false prophets will arise and perform great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the elect.”
